verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major wrong-answer finding. ListExpander now chooses a prefix fresh against every blank label reachable through rows, including nested lists, formulae, and quoted triples; both the query-answer path and the closure/proof path seed the expander with all rows it will process. The new end-to-end regression projects the formerly colliding _l1 blank alongside a two-cell list and verifies that the projected node receives no rdf:first/rest structure. The query API tests exercise the real matcher for comparison and functional builtins, lists, formulae, backward rules, projection-over-closure behavior, deduplication, and the no-forward-rule error. The public API and wasm/package documentation are updated consistently. No remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the diff-scoped evidence.
